scientific_integrity: Exact Fourier identities and the uniform phase estimate prove the arbitrary-graph bound. Character factorization, a central limit theorem and a controlled transverse-coin contribution prove sharpness; finite numerical checks are corroboration, not proof. Literature-wide priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The sharp exponent is for one-shot position measurement in the parity-matched time window, over unrestricted distinct nonzero Boolean generators. The saturating connected graphs have growing ambient dimension and a nonzero adjacent XOR target; no claim is made about optimality over all times, noise or all graph families.
title: Sharp cubic-root transfer infidelity for Grover walks on cubelike graphs
